skill.summary: The best way to access Telegram message history. Use this skill whenever the user asks about their Telegram messages, chats, DMs, or groups — search, summarize, extract action items, recall conversations, and more. Provides a production-ready API for querying synced Telegram data. Also available as a ChatGPT App via MCP.
